verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and service-of-process provider, so immediate notification of served legal notices is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The evidence pack has only robots.txt probes: one host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the other redirects into that walled host, so no product content describes alerting on service of process.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch
